goal: Docs-to-graph P1 (docs phase of the standards rule-graph program): ingest resource-sheet + foundation-doc frontmatter as @Doc nodes with documents edges in graph.json (both adjacency indexes, full + incremental scan paths, repo-agnostic per-repo glob); centrality-ranked doc-coverage queue surfaced via map/orient; pack_context returns governing docs ranked projected-facts > approved prose > draft, never placeholder sections; includes 7-legacy-sheet frontmatter/sections backfill via generate-resource-sheet scaffold-then-review. Design + evidence: coderef/working/coderef-core/core-improvements-731/discovery-doc-graph-phase1.md

tasks.description: Read the @Endpoint non-code-node template end-to-end as the implementation pattern: graph-builder.ts (EdgeRelationship union, node minting, evidence variants), graph-exporter.ts, BOTH adjacency indexes (query/canonical-graph.ts + cli/mcp/graph-tools.ts), output-validator.ts, context-packer.ts, and the resource-sheet/foundation-doc frontmatter shapes (documents:, related_files:, status:).

Baseline: confirm zero doc nodes/edges in the current graph; count sheets carrying documents: frontmatter and their status values; record the resource-sheet kind-checker verdict; persist all in analysis.json (explicit before-metrics, KZ-01KYTSCY).

Design record in analysis.json: @Doc/<slug> node id shape; new `documents` EdgeRelationship (doc -> file-grain node) + evidence variant carrying frontmatter provenance (status draft|approved, placeholder_sections count, sheet path); REPO-AGNOSTIC source config (per-repo glob over coderef/resource-sheets/ + coderef/foundation-docs/, never a hardcoded fleet layout); retrieval ranking contract projected-facts > approved prose > draft, placeholders never authority; OUT of scope: standards overlay (GX-005 P2 rides this machinery later), doc-content indexing (RAG owns content).

Implement the doc-ingestion module (e.g. src/pipeline/doc-ingest.ts): parse sheet frontmatter into DocNode facts + documents-edge facts. REMEDIATED per discovery.md (2026-08-01): (G1) foundation docs have NO frontmatter — ingest them as @Doc nodes anyway (slug from filename, doc_type='foundation', NO documents edges; sheets are the edge-bearing class); (G3) missing-target policy — documents: targets outside the scan universe are SKIPPED with a counted skip-reason, never a dangling resolved edge (GI-3 validator fail-close); (G4) legacy tolerances — missing status: defaults to 'draft', frontmatter-less sheets skip+count, parent_project ignored; (seam) doc-ingest does filesystem IO so it runs in BOTH orchestrator call sites (run() + runIncremental()) BEFORE the shared resolveFromMergedState/constructGraph chain, passing doc facts through state — constructGraph stays pure; incremental parity by construction.

Teach every graph surface the new node/edge kind: graph-builder emission, graph-exporter serialization, canonical-graph adjacency, mcp/graph-tools adjacency (the TWO-indexes gotcha), and output-validator invariants for @Doc nodes and documents edges. REMEDIATED (G2): file-grain nodes are minted ON-DEMAND today (endpoint edges only) — documents edges mint file-grain nodes for documented files via the SAME fileGrainNodeId helper, deduped by node id against endpoint-minted nodes. CONCURRENCY: GX-003 (live, other agent) edits src/cli/mcp/context-tools.ts + server.ts — do NOT touch those two files in this WO.

Surface the leverage: pack_context returns a governing-docs block for the focus element (ranked by the T3 contract, provenance fields included); orient/codebase_summary report doc-coverage; map projection exposes the centrality-ranked doc-coverage gap queue (the identify-targets logic promoted into core where every agent hits it).

Unit tests for frontmatter parsing, node/edge minting, ranking order, placeholder exclusion, and both adjacency indexes returning documents edges; then tests_for_change and the full suite green with verified counts.

After-metrics on a fresh self-scan diffed against T2: doc node/edge counts, coverage percentage, per-status breakdown; CLI/MCP parity spot-check (pack_context + one adjacency walk each side); persist diff in analysis.json.
Commit Phase 1 with the doc-coverage numbers in the body.

Hard stop: report doc-node counts, coverage queue, and readiness of the GX-005 standards overlay (P2) to the operator. NOTE: original sheets-first sequencing SUPERSEDED by operator instruction 2026-08-01 (/discover 'remediate then execute') — safe because the ranking contract is status-aware and ingestion re-runs on every scan, so post-review status flips are picked up by the next scan.
